sky.qualification: Bienor's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons heliocentric state at the fixed 2026-09-03 TT scene epoch. The adopted prograde ecliptic pole is longitude 35° ± 8°, latitude +50° ± 3°. The 2024 study validates this pole over 22 years and uses its refined 9.1736 h period to compute rotational phase. Ecliptic J2000 coordinates are converted to ICRF using the established preparation recipe. The displayed longitude origin and absolute rotational phase are arbitrary.
provenance.qualification: Computed Bienor Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
